svg.title: NCM release execution: eight ordered steps
svg.desc: An explicit approval triggers GitHub Actions. Steps 1 to 4 verify inputs, prepare an image, test the model/runtime pair, and commit candidate configuration. Steps 5 to 8 deploy and validate the candidate, commit the role assignment, and verify the serving release. Both test reports must pass; failed stages block dependent jobs.

text.tspan: Eight steps from an approved model to a verified serving release.
S3 upload and draft selection do not start release work.
One workflow; dependent jobs advance on success.
One approval covers both deployment and activation.
Bound to this operation and attempt
Build if needed; publish to ECR.
Same digest for tests and deployment
and failure checks through the API.
